scope: Linux x64 standalone Wasmtime preview environment repair in stock Node, Deno and Bun. Empty and above-one-MiB environments match fresh native interpreted/C-compiled Lean; not managed CLI or whole API acceptance.
changes: Allow zero entries/bytes without dereferencing or copying a null buffer.
Remove the diagnostic one-MiB environment limit.
Retain terminator/count checks, checked pointer-table size multiplication, guest range checks and allocation errors.
